name: jspaint-site-builder-workers
description: Cloudflare Workers for the site builder: the sandboxed `sites` Worker that serves ~name pages from R2, and the `editor` Worker (Paint app + API).

scripts.dev:editor: npm run build:editor && wrangler dev -c editor/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.deploy:editor: npm run build:editor && wrangler deploy -c editor/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:sites && npm run deploy:editor
